name: ActionBar
purpose: Detached contextual action layer with controlled disclosure, dismissal and focus policy.
useWhen: Selection or application context exposes temporary actions without an anchor.

avoidWhen.condition: The panel must be anchored to a trigger.
Actions are a persistent keyboard composite.

composition: Compose ActionBar.Root, Portal, optional Positioner and named Content. Use Positioner for fixed wrappers so visual layering follows the shared overlay stack. Supply selection count and action buttons yourself. Use CloseTrigger asChild for an existing button.

rules.statement: Keep record selection, translated messages and business effects application-owned. Closing does not clear selection.
Name Content through Title or native aria-label. Default initialFocus is false; nonmodal opening preserves selection focus.
Use closeOnInteractOutside=false or persistentElements for continued collection selection. Set unmountOnExit=false to retain child state.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using an invisible trigger to anchor bulk actions.
commonMistakes.correction: ActionBar is detached and needs no trigger or anchor.

validation: Verify Tab access, Escape, cancellation, nested layers, outside dismissal, selection persistence and mount policy.
